analysis:
Examined CHANGELOG.md head lines 806-1243 (units 29 and 30). These lines are unchanged historical release-note text: the complete range map shows head changes only at lines 11-39 (the new v0.10.10 waitlist section). The text describes cluster tensor-parallel and pipeline planning, rollback following, prefix-cache reuse on pairs (lines 909, 1102-1105, relevant to T-041 and SEC-035; cache scoping via cacheSalt is not claimed changed), the enabled-model filter (line 991), App Attest lease display (lines 1002, 879; T-057 and A-016 are status-only, and unenroll still requires fresh renewal) and sandbox setup plan sizing (lines 1128-1142; TB-013, T-061). Because this documentation is unchanged, it introduces no security regression.

The changed head lines 11-39, visible only in the patch excerpt, introduce waitlist approval gating for new sandbox and cluster setups through coordinator-reported approval. They also include the line "If the coordinator does not offer waitlists yet, both new setups go on as in 0.…", which suggests the gate fails open when the coordinator lacks the feature. That gate is an access and product-rollout control, not a trust or attestation control. Whether it fails open on an unreachable coordinator versus an unsupported one, and how existing setups are detected, must be checked in the source passes for the CLI and cluster code.

The threat model has no waitlist entries. TB-013 and T-061 may need a note that the approval comes from the coordinator and is client-side enforced. No source code was supplied in this batch.
